title: Input journal open failure omits provider cancellation

significance.impact: A failed write can leave the native peer running without durable input acceptance until another lifecycle mechanism stops it.
significance.exposure: Uncommitted SDK transport candidate; production interactive approval remains disabled. Only planted peers and zero-model initialization exercised this code.
significance.detectability: The write raises PermissionError, but the caller cannot infer that provider cancellation was signalled.
significance.systemic_implication: A bounded transport lifecycle defect; no evidence of a failure outside this transport seam.
significance.recovery: Repair and replay a new bounded observation; retained failed observations remain unchanged.
significance.rationale: Material failure of the new transport's resource or lifecycle contract, contained before production use.

confidence.basis: Source inspection and an intended pre-fix behavioral assertion failure.

evidence.observation: Ten tests passed; the injected journal-open failure test failed its cancellation-event assertion.

claim.failure_mode: The first candidate opened the input journal outside the exception boundary that signals cancellation.
claim.downstream_consequence: A failed write can leave the native peer running without durable input acceptance until another lifecycle mechanism stops it.

counterevidence.observation: The production interactive approval route remains rejected.

proof_limits: The Git revision is the candidate base; exact candidate and repaired hashes are retained in sdk-transport-review.md.
This transport finding does not itself establish native permission enforcement, installed routing, or hostile same-user isolation.

remediation.description: Include journal open, write, fsync and close in the cancellation-setting failure boundary.

evidence.observation: Include journal open, write, fsync and close in the cancellation-setting failure boundary.

performed.independence_basis: Separate read-only review context inspected the repaired source and permanent assertion; parent-executed planted failure and repaired test outcomes are retained separately.

evidence.observation: The retained pre-repair failure, repaired focused checks, independent source re-review, and 606-pass full source suite discharge this transport-local defect; native approval enforcement remains outside this finding's closure.

performed.negative_control: Planted journal-open PermissionError rejected the original outside-handler open at the missing-cancellation assertion in sdk-transport-first.xml; the same regression passed after repair.
